name: Purisys / Noramco (Siegfried)

summary: Patented chemical-synthesis CBD (not pure extraction) plus Extractas Bioscience's extraction; >50 cannabinoids claimed; quote-based pricing

name: GVB Biopharma
summary: Large-scale hemp extraction; claims 12,000+ kg/mo CBD/CBG/CBN isolate; commodity majors only, no rare-cannabinoid or custom-derivative service

name: Avicanna
summary: Colombia-based extraction (Santa Marta Golden Hemp) plus finished pharma/consumer products; Trunerox got Colombia's first indication-specific cannabinoid drug registration

name: Willow Biosciences
status: Defunct — renamed Atlas Energy Corp (oil & gas) June 2025
summary: Cannabinoid IP and R&D team sold to Mycofeast Ltd for $2.76M (Apr 2025); no longer a cannabinoid company

name: InMed Pharmaceuticals / BayMedica
summary: E. coli biosynthesis (IntegraSyn), rare cannabinoids at ~5 g/L yield; BayMedica exiting due to H.R. 5371 federal hemp law (Nov 2025); InMed reverse-merging into Mentari Therapeutics, Q4 2026

name: CB Therapeutics
summary: Engineered-yeast precision fermentation for cannabinoids plus tryptamines/psychedelics; Cleveland Clinic collaboration (2020); current pricing/COA data unconfirmed

name: Lygos Inc.
summary: Fermentation-based "Lygos CBx" line ran 2020-2021 with no activity since; current business is industrial malonates/polymers, unrelated to cannabinoids

name: Cerilliant (MilliporeSigma)
summary: Certified reference standards at mg-scale ampules for instrument calibration; ISO 17025/17034 accredited; DEA bulk-manufacturer application pending (2026)

name: Cayman Chemical
summary: Research-reagent scale (5-50mg CBD standard); DEA bulk-manufacturer application pending since Aug 2025; no cannabinoid cGMP product yet

name: Chiron AS (ZeptoMetrix / Antylia)
summary: Norwegian reference-standard manufacturer since 1983; part of Antylia/ZeptoMetrix since 2023; analytical/forensic CRMs

name: Waystone Pharmaceuticals
summary: Jointly building a natural-product/cannabinoid derivative library targeting inflammatory bowel disease; no public progress update since the original LOI

name: Parchem Fine & Specialty Chemicals
summary: Established specialty-chemical distributor already running an active cannabinoid channel (CBD isolate/CBDA/CBG) with DEA List I registration

name: Cambrex Corporation
summary: DEA-licensed Schedule II-V small-molecule CDMO, mg to 100kg batch scale, no cannabinoid product line (non-conflicted)

name: ProVerde Laboratories
summary: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited lab in Massachusetts (same state as CitraChem HQ), pharma/biotech client base beyond retail cannabis compliance

name: Marken (UPS Healthcare)
summary: Clinical-trial logistics network with DEA-licensed depots for controlled substances and cold-chain/deep-frozen handling capability

name: Association of Cannabinoid Specialists
summary: 501(c)3 nonprofit of practicing cannabinoid-medicine clinicians; credibility and referral opportunity

name: Berje Inc.
summary: Family-owned essential oils/aromatic chemicals supplier since 1949
